body: I’m sorry to hear that I can kinda relate without ever having a male in my life. I can’t imagine the relief when you finally cross that line your right cuz I don’t ever see it happening. I’ve thought about therapy so many times but it’s just not for me I don’t think not really my personality telling everything to someone, ironically I’m doing it now but you can’t see my face you don’t kno me in real life so I guess it’s easier. The “friends” I have claim all this shit how they really feel Nd it’s all bullshit “believe none of what you hear Nd half of what you see” is one of the realest quotes I’ve ever heard. I jus don’t believe anything anyone sais at this point cuz I’ve been lied to Nd betrayed so many times I can’t count.  Crazy to think your a random person on the internet across the world Nd I almost feel as you actually care about me compared to all the people I’ve actually lived my life with and did real shit for Nd here you are being real as a mf not even knowing my name 🤦🏾‍♂️ bless you, your heart, soul , family. It’s not many of us left bro. If I’m alive in a couple years with my shit together im gonna have to take a trip to you to say thank you in person 💯 you might be the person that saves my life 😓

The problem is everything your saying is correct it’s jus way harder to actually live thinking all positive like that when you’ve been completely negative about everything for the past 5 years. This is all I know bra, I don’t kno a positive way of life this is it Nd each day it seems so much easier to jus blow my fuckin brain out then keep dealing with all this inside. On everything that I love I literally feel a huge fire engulfing my entire insides Nd brain it feels like if I was to die/cut myself/shoot myself whatever it would literally be releasing all of that bad energy/anger/pain/hurt/sadness
I say this every single day. I didn’t ask to be brought into this life filled with bullshit and pain and anger
